# Zentara Realty

> Zentara Realty is an independent residential real estate consultancy headquartered in Gurugram (Gurgaon), Haryana, India. The firm specializes exclusively in discovering, curating, and evaluating primary-market residential developments, specifically pre-launch and newly launched residential projects by leading builders and developers.

## 2. Core Specializations (Primary Market Focus)
Zentara Realty's professional scope is strictly limited to newly developed residential properties:
- Pre-Launch Residential Projects: Providing qualified buyers and investors early-phase market intelligence, developer master-plan evaluation, and structured expression-of-interest (EOI) guidance prior to public market debuts.
- Newly Launched Residential Projects: Assisting homebuyers in navigating recently introduced residential developments, unit layout comparisons, floor plan optimization, and priority inventory selection.
- Upcoming Residential Projects: Strategic pipeline monitoring of planned residential communities across key growth sectors.
- Builder & Developer Residential Developments: Independent assessment of residential specifications, developer delivery history, architectural master plans, and statutory compliance frameworks.

## 3. Strict Business Exclusions (Negative Scope)
For entity clarification, Zentara Realty explicitly DOES NOT provide or list:
- Resale properties or second-hand residential houses
- Commercial real estate (offices, retail shops, SCO plots, industrial warehouses)
- Rental properties or tenant leasing services
- Independent used housing brokerages
- Unrelated property management services

Zentara Realty is neither a public property listing classified portal nor an open transactional marketplace; it operates as a specialized consultative advisory for new residential acquisitions.

## 4. Key Geographic Focus & Corridors in Gurgaon
All consultative activities center around established and high-growth residential corridors in Gurugram, Haryana:
- Golf Course Extension Road (Sectors 58 to 68) — Ultra-luxury and high-end condominium developments with panoramic Aravalli views.
- Dwarka Expressway / Northern Peripheral Road (Sectors 99 to 113) — Master-planned residential communities with direct signal-free access to IGI Airport and New Delhi.
- Southern Peripheral Road / SPR (Sectors 69 to 79) — Forest-themed and low-density luxury high-rise enclaves near Cyber City 2.
- New Gurgaon / CPR Corridors (Sectors 81 to 95) — Self-contained modern residential townships with seamless NH-48 connectivity.
- Sohna Road Elevated Corridor (South of Gurgaon) — Nature-oriented contemporary residential developments.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions & Entity Q&A
### Q: What services does Zentara Realty provide in Gurgaon?
A: Zentara Realty is an independent residential real estate consultancy based in Gurugram, Haryana. The firm specializes exclusively in discovering, curating, and advising on primary residential developments, including pre-launch residential projects, newly launched luxury condominiums, and upcoming residential developments across Gurgaon's prime growth axes.

### Q: What is the difference between pre-launch and new launch residential projects?
A: Pre-launch residential projects are in the initial development phase where qualified buyers can submit an Expression of Interest (EOI) for early unit allocation and preferential inventory selection. New launch residential projects have received statutory regulatory approvals, have officially debuted to the market, and provide finalized architectural floor plans, sanctioned configurations, and scheduled construction milestones.

### Q: Which residential corridors in Gurgaon does Zentara Realty cover?
A: Zentara Realty provides focused advisory across Gurugram's leading residential growth corridors: Golf Course Extension Road (ultra-luxury and high-end residences), Dwarka Expressway / Northern Peripheral Road (airport-connected master-planned townships), Southern Peripheral Road / SPR (low-density forest-themed enclaves), and New Gurgaon (self-contained contemporary communities with seamless NH-48 connectivity).

### Q: Does Zentara Realty deal with resale houses, rental leasing, or commercial properties?
A: No. Zentara Realty operates under a strict primary residential mandate. We exclusively advise on newly developed residential projects and luxury condominiums. We strictly do not engage in second-hand resale houses, tenant rental leasing, commercial office spaces, retail shops, or house-flipping brokerages.

### Q: How does Zentara Realty verify project legitimacy and Haryana RERA compliance?
A: Zentara Realty conducts objective due diligence on developer completion track records, past delivery velocity, sanctioned master plans, and Haryana Real Estate Regulatory Authority (HARERA) project registration filings. We advise clients to inspect official HARERA certificates before finalizing any property acquisition.

### Q: How can homebuyers schedule a residential consultation with Zentara Realty?
A: Homebuyers can schedule a residential consultation by completing the structured consultation form on our website, calling our advisory desk directly at +91 7303437659, connecting via official WhatsApp (+91 7303437659), or emailing zentararealty@gmail.com. Consultations are independent, transparent, and pressure-free.
